scene: Warm steam greets you inside the hilltop hut smelling of roasted barley.
picture: A flat side view inside the wooden hut along one level floor. Left, a bubbling brass kettle sits upon a stone hearth. The lanky boy in his orange puffer vest and kite stands centre-left facing right. In the centre, a pinned wind map hangs above wooden shelves. Far right, a fox sleeps upon a mat.
shown: a bubbling brass kettle whistling softly on a stone stove on the left
a hand-drawn parchment map of flight currents pinned in the centre
a curled orange fox napping on a braided mat on the far right
